name: ano
description: Vintage of the Valor 1000 inventory used as seed A.
observations: Added in staging; not in the CSV.

name: identificador
description: Source inventory key: 14-digit CNPJ, closed-group slug (folha/globo/havan/record), or the sentinel vazio when the magazine row has no CNPJ.
observations: Not unique. Hundreds of rows share vazio.

name: id_cnpj
description: 14-digit CNPJ when identificador is digits-only; null for slugs and vazio.

name: nome
description: Display name as published in the walk inventory (razão-ish, not a legal name key).

name: tipo_societario
description: Legal form as classified in the inventory.

name: indicador_grafo
description: Whether the company already sits on the frozen v0 public graph.

name: motivo
description: Free-text reason the row is in the inventory (rank family, extra, skip).

name: situacao_passeio
description: Walk status assigned when the inventory was built.

name: indicador_formulario
description: Whether a Formulário de Referência shareholder file was found.
